result:
I’d make sure every person has a real foundation beneath them: food, shelter, healthcare, education, and safety—regardless of where they were born.

Not unlimited wealth, but enough security that nobody has to trade their dignity for survival. I think much of the world’s cruelty comes from scarcity and fear, and removing that pressure would change how people treat one another.
